## Problem or opportunity

What problem does this solve, and for whom (parent or child)?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you would like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about.

## Fit with the product

- [ ] This is inside the approved MVP scope (`docs/MVP_SCOPE.md`).
- [ ] This is a future idea, out of current MVP scope.

> Note: features on the MVP restriction list in `CLAUDE.md` (public child
> profiles, messaging, social feeds, leaderboards, advertising, AI chat
> companions, native apps, etc.) require explicit approval before work begins.

## Product principles check

Does this align with the principles in `docs/CURRICULUM_PRINCIPLES.md` and the
privacy posture in `docs/PRIVACY_AND_SAFETY.md`? Note any tension.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps evaluate the request.
